title: Repro2 parity test against baseline
summary: EXP-032 baseline parity was perfect, but EXP-033 current repro2 collapsed PASS-eligible controls to BLOCK (tp_pass = 0, balanced_accuracy = 0.5) via a threshold gate. Zero dangerous false-pass was preserved, but promotion parity failed.
findings: Baseline (EXP-032) balanced accuracy = 1.0; current (EXP-033 repro2) balanced accuracy = 0.5
Pass recall collapsed from 1.00 to 0.00 in the repro2 run
No dangerous false-pass: governance boundary held
Failure surface localised to end-to-end reliability threshold gate (R5_e2e_floor)
